skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations and methodologies of modern economics, focusing on social conventions and legal regulations influencing economic behavior.
Analyze the impact of institutions on economic growth and development, including transaction costs, property rights, social capital, and corruption.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate institutional quality and its impact on economic development in Vietnam and other developing countries.
Conduct research and analyze data to assess institutional quality and its impact on economic development.
Effectively communicate research findings and institutional analysis in presentations and discussions.
Work collaboratively in groups to analyze and present institutional issues and solutions.
Understand and apply ethical principles in economic analysis and decision-making.
Analyze and interpret data related to institutional quality, social capital, and corruption.
Develop and apply economic models to analyze institutional behavior and economic outcomes.
Evaluate and propose policies based on institutional analysis and economic research.
